reviewer: independent source research agent, not builder
scope: Visual and source-identity comparison only; not structural, watertightness, slicing or physical-print certification.

checks.identity_novelty: Official DYU page directly links this album; detached 學思亭 is not the existing DYU library core or similarly named NTUNHS pavilion.
checks.complete_geometry: Four square red corner shafts and continuous upper/lower red beam bands preserved. Roof and pad represent coherent pavilion, not a facade slice.
checks.roof_topology: Four planar slopes converge on central square hood; hood has shallow four-slope cap, visible in elevation/oblique views. Not gabled or long-ridge roof.
checks.overhang: 108 mm eave versus 96 mm column-center span gives small overhang consistent with photograph; prior 120 mm trial was corrected before this review.
checks.rails_entry: Three sides of black rails, entrance remains open. Count/thickness are approximate.
checks.stone: Broad thick gray upper block on narrower lower pedestal; no invented text or purpose.
checks.benches: Three source-visible benches on each side plus one freestanding front bench, with leg voids. Occluded rear seat segmentation intentionally omitted and disclosed.
checks.color: Red frame, gray-brown roof, pale gridded opaque hood, gray stone/pad and black rail/bench bases are compatible photo-informed appearance, not calibrated paint values.
checks.previews: All five actual delivered PNGs personally viewed at full frame: front/elevation/rear/top/left_oblique. No source-photo texture presented as geometry.

limitations: Historical source photos record 2003–2012; current official panorama has unknown capture date. Not 2026 survey or guaranteed present condition.
No measured dimensions or architectural plan. Ratios, seam counts, railing subdivisions and precise material values approximated.
Hood grid simplified to two broad rows rather than reproducing every source cell; opaque backed interpretation, no claimed glass transparency.
Hidden rear furniture, roof internal engineering, landscape, hillside stair and light omitted.
Technical QA must pass separately; visual PASS does not override thin-feature failures or authorize publication.
publication_guard: Keep raw photos private. Root/school/campus primary galleries only, no duplicate footer. Independent technical review still required.
